use_when: Artifact images need focusable zoom and gallery navigation
do_not_use_when: Simple inline images need no modal viewer
accessibility: Use semantic HTML and accessible names
Verify keyboard behavior and focus visibility
responsive: Check desktop, tablet and narrow mobile
verification: Run fresh installed package React render smoke
Check keyboard focus and mouse interactions
Test semantic labels and mobile overflow
Verify external content claims and asset rights
Verify focus returns to opener on close
Verify Escape, left/right arrow and zoom controls

agent_policy.reuse_requires: Stable API, reviewed contract, and independent consumer verification

constraints: Images must have accessible alt text
Focus must return to opener on close
Zoom must not overflow document viewport
